children.text: I started Reid Design because I believe everyone deserves a home that reflects who they actually are, not just what's trending this season. I'm Staci Perkins, and I bring the same care to a bedroom refresh as I do to a full-home renovation.
Every project begins with listening. Your life, your habits, your aesthetic, those come first. The furniture and finishes follow. Let's figure out what your space is missing.
